build_process_group_stats_monitor: build a Python module that uses ProcessGroupStatsMonitor to collect per-rank CPU, memory, and disk IO stats in a subprocess
create_process_group_resource_usage: create a ProcessGroupResourceUsage dataclass to snapshot CPU percent, RSS, PSS, private bytes, disk IO, and network bytes for a process group
run_collect_pgrp_stats: run _collect_pgrp_stats to gather CPU, memory, disk IO, and network stats across all processes sharing the current PGID
review_parse_proc_stat: review the _parse_proc_stat function that parses /proc/[pid]/stat to extract pgrp, utime, stime, and rss fields
summarize_read_pgrp_stats: summarize the _read_pgrp_stats function that aggregates CPU, RSS, PSS, private memory, and disk IO across all PIDs in the process group
